title: Computational corpus and Textual Emotion Classification (TEC) pipeline for Saint Neophytos the Recluse's Ten Discourses on Christ's Commandments
description:
Preprocessing pipeline and few-shot emotion classification workflow for the Ten Discourses on Christ's Commandments (Δέκα Λόγοι περὶ τοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἐντολῶν) of Saint Neophytos the Recluse (Neophytos / Neofytos, 1134 – c. 1214).

Part of a postdoctoral project at the University of Nicosia on computational sentiment and emotion analysis of Byzantine patristic Greek. It continues the author's PhD research on the use of Holy Scripture in Neophytos's works.
